results.purpose: Resolve a known work to EXACT+id; an unknown to NONE. Never invent.
results.proved: the resolver distinguishes an exact hit from a miss, and does not fabricate an entity for garbage.
results.relevance: an agent must get a stable work_id before any downstream call; guessing an id poisons every later claim.

results.purpose: Passage evidence returns layers + per-layer sha256 + review state.
results.proved: the evidence payload is hash-bearing and its review state is honest by default.
results.relevance: an agent quoting a passage must be able to hand the reader a hash and the real review state, not a claim of review.

results.purpose: formal__trace -> COMPLETE + named theorems; formal__gaps -> denominator.
results.proved: the formal chain resolves to named, registered Lean theorems, and gaps carry a total.
results.relevance: COMPLETE-with-named-theorems is the difference between 'we checked it' and 'trust us'; an agent must show the names.

results.purpose: Coverage is a fraction; gap_count equals the gaps list (or says truncated).
results.proved: coverage is never a bare headline: it carries a denominator and a gap list consistent with gap_count.
results.relevance: the whole estate's honesty depends on never quoting a coverage number without its gap list; this proves the payload can't lie about it.

results.purpose: Fetch verify pack + source (and a layer) artifact; recompute sha256.
results.proved: an outsider recomputes the published bytes' sha256 with no code/account and it matches the recorded hash.
results.relevance: this is the answer to 'how do I know this is real?' — fetch the bytes, sha256sum, compare. If this fails, nothing else is citable.

results.purpose: Chained identity -> evidence (verse) -> proof (chunk), identity BOUND.
results.proved: one work carries the whole chain end to end and the trace's identity hop binds to the resolved work.
results.relevance: this is the actual task an agent does: resolve, read, prove, with identity consistent across all three.

results.purpose: Unknown tool + bad target error; empty query is NONE/INVALID_QUERY.
results.proved: the surface fails closed: bad input errors, empty input resolves to nothing, never a silent success.
results.relevance: an agent must be able to trust that an empty answer means 'no result', not 'the tool quietly did nothing'.

results.purpose: COMPLETE trace may coexist with withheld reading; both stated.
results.proved: a proof-complete chunk may still withhold its reading, and the surface says which — no silent empty.
results.relevance: prevents an agent from assuming 'proof exists => passage readable' and inventing a reading where none is served.

observed.note: proof may be COMPLETE while reading is withheld — both stated
